title: kate-ui: find bar state over kate-search
summary: kate-ui gains the kate-search dependency and findbar.rs. FindState wraps a kate_search::FindBar with the open flags. Three functions turn a find, a replace one, and a replace all into Commands: MoveTo for a hit and ReplaceRanges for the edits. The GPUI bar comes in the next packet.

lane.reason: A Cursor local agent on the owner Mac codes this packet. The file has no GPUI import, but kate-ui tests run in the rust (macos-15) job and the Mac lane owns crates/kate-ui.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: Add kate-search to the kate-ui dependencies for every target with the justification comment above. Run cargo update -p kate-ui so Cargo.lock gains the edge and nothing else changes. Create findbar.rs with the SPDX header and add mod findbar; to lib.rs with the same dead_code attribute as files. find_command calls state.bar.find_from(buf, from); Ok(Some(hit)) becomes Command::MoveTo of one selection with anchor hit.range.start() and head hit.range.end(); Ok(None) and Err return None. replace_one_command calls bar.replace_one and replace_all_command calls bar.replace_all; each maps the Transaction with pairs_from into Command::ReplaceRanges; an empty transaction returns None. pairs_from maps each Edit to CharRange::new(edit.start, edit.old_end()) and edit.new. kate_search::FindBar needs Default; when it has none, build it field by field in FindState::default. The test module builds a TextBuffer from a string, so it runs on Linux too. The test find_command_moves_to_the_hit uses text foo bar foo, pattern foo, from Offset(1), and asserts MoveTo with one selection 8..11; replace_all_command with replacement x asserts ReplaceRanges with pairs (0..3, x) and (8..11, x). Do not nest an if inside an if. When two arms return the same value, write one condition with ||. Add each new test at the end of the one test module of the file, before its closing brace; create that module when the file is new. Do not write a second mod tests. An item with no caller outside tests gets #[cfg_attr(not(test), allow(dead_code))]; the packet that adds the caller removes it. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip.

regression_tests.name: findbar::tests::find_command_moves_to_the_hit
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main because findbar.rs does not exist. After the change a find is a MoveTo of the hit and a replace all is one ReplaceRanges with every hit.
